verdict.why: Inline projects now extend the root config by default, which changes their resolved config.

draft.detail: Projects defined with an inline configuration inherit options from the root-level configuration by default since Vitest 5.0.

test.error: FAIL: the inline project without extends did not inherit the root setupFiles

source.quote: Projects defined with an inline configuration inherit all options from the root-level configuration. This is controlled by the `extends` option, which is enabled by default since Vitest 5.0:
